symptom: toml 0.10.2's decoder crashes with IndexError in load_array while parsing an array that mixes a string with an inline table: the array loader splits the array text on commas and then re-joins pieces it decides were split inside a value, but with a trailing comma after the inline table it re-joins past the end of the list. Unfixed in the 0.10.x line (the project is unmaintained; tomli/tomllib parse the input).

output_contains: IndexError: list index out of range
